purpose: Curated demonstration cases for Step 10 packaging and portfolio demonstrations.

demo_cases.title: Typical Successful Investigation
demo_cases.selection_rationale: Representative successful investigation with a moderate finding count and evidence-grounded temporal findings. Suitable for the default live CLI demonstration.

demo_cases.title: Evidence-Rich Temporal Reconstruction
demo_cases.selection_rationale: Evidence-rich case with substantial evidence, clinical-claim, timeline, and medication artifacts consolidated into 15 temporal uncertainty findings without requiring human review.

demo_cases.title: Human-Review Medication Discrepancy
demo_cases.selection_rationale: Safety-oriented demonstration case containing a high-severity lisinopril dose conflict that triggers human review while preserving the machine-generated investigation report.
